시편 113:1.content: Praise ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.

시편 113:2.content: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.

시편 113:3.content: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the Lord’s name is to be praised.

시편 113:4.content: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

시편 113:5.content: Who is like unto the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high,

시편 113:6.content: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

시편 113:7.content: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

시편 113:8.content: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

시편 113:9.content: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord.
